head: America laughed
at Hyundai.
slides.sub: So Hyundai made a promise no rival would match.

image.label: A small 1980s hatchback under a spotlight
image.brief: 1980년대 작은 해치백이 스포트라이트 아래 서 있고, 뒤쪽 객석에서 웃음이 터지는 듯한 분위기. 실제 차 디자인과 로고는 쓰지 않음.

head: A record start.
Then the jokes.
body: Hyundai began selling cars in the US in 1986. Its small, cheap Excel sold in huge numbers that first year.
Then the problems showed up. Quality complaints piled up, and the brand became a punchline.

image.label: Rows of small cars at a 1986 dealership
image.brief: 1986년 미국 딜러십에 줄지어 선 작은 차들과 몰려든 손님들.

slides.label: Hyundai cars sold in the US in 1998, far below its early peak
body: Dealers were struggling, and some observers expected Hyundai to give up on America.

image.label: An almost empty car lot
image.brief: 거의 빈 자동차 전시장과 혼자 서 있는 영업사원.

head: The cars got better.
Nobody believed it.
body: Back home, Hyundai was pushing hard on quality. But buyers judged it by its old reputation.
An ad saying "we have improved" was easy to ignore.

image.label: Engineers testing a car in a Korean factory
image.brief: 한국 공장에서 엔지니어들이 차량을 정밀 점검하는 장면.

head: Your cars are better.
How do you prove it?
body: Buyers think your cars break down. Your engineers say that is no longer true.

options.text: Cut prices further to win buyers back
options.feedback: Cheaper cars can deepen the "cheap and unreliable" image. Keep swiping.

options.text: Run ads about better quality ratings
options.feedback: Fair, but buyers discount what a brand says about itself. Keep swiping.

options.text: Pay for repairs for years longer than any rival
options.feedback: Very costly if you are wrong. Keep swiping to see what Hyundai did.

image.label: A handshake over a car key

head: 10 years.
100,000 miles.
body: In 1998, Hyundai Motor America launched what it called "America's Best Warranty": 10 years or 100,000 miles on the engine and transmission.
That was far longer than the usual coverage at the time.

image.label: A warranty card with a long line of years
image.brief: 여러 해가 이어진 보증서 그래픽. 긴 시간을 상징하는 달력.

head: A promise that only
works if it is true.
body: If the cars were still unreliable, the warranty would cost Hyundai a fortune. That risk is what made the promise believable.
Buyers did not have to trust Hyundai's words. They could trust its exposure.

image.label: A repair shop with an invoice stamped "paid by Hyundai"
image.brief: 정비소 계산대에 놓인 "제조사 부담" 도장이 찍힌 수리비 영수증.

slides.label: growth in Hyundai's US sales, from about 90,000 in 1998 to 418,615 in 2004
body: Quality caught up too. In J.D. Power's 2004 initial quality study, Hyundai tied Honda for second place, behind only Toyota.

image.label: A rising sales line over a highway
image.brief: 고속도로 위로 겹쳐진 상승하는 판매 그래프.

head: Do not claim it.
Bet on it.
body: When customers doubt you, words are cheap. A guarantee is a **costly signal**: you only offer it if you are confident, because you pay if you are wrong.
Hyundai answered the buyer's biggest objection, the fear of a lemon, by taking that risk itself.

image.label: A guarantee seal on a car door
image.brief: 자동차 문 위에 붙은 보증 인장 그래픽.

head: What would you promise
if you really believed?
body: The fastest way to earn trust is to take on the risk your customer fears.
**Try it today:** write down your customers' biggest worry about buying from you. What guarantee would take that risk off them?

image.label: A car driving into the sunrise
image.brief: 해 뜨는 도로를 달리는 차 한 대.

factChecks.note: 1986년 미국 진출과 첫해 Excel 판매(약 16만 8천 대, 수입차 첫해 기록으로 자주 인용)는 Hyundai Motor America 자료로 확인하세요. 카드에는 숫자 없이 "huge numbers"로만 적었습니다.
1998년 미국 판매 약 9만 대(90,217대로 보도)는 Hyundai 판매 실적 발표로 확인하세요. → [2026-11-02 확인] 1998년 약 9만 대 확인(정확한 90,217대는 미확인).
"America's Best Warranty"(1998년, 파워트레인 10년/10만 마일, 기본 5년/6만 마일)는 당시 Hyundai Motor America 발표와 보도 기준입니다. → [2026-11-02 확인] 10년/10만 마일 파워트레인 보증과 Finbarr O'Neill 확인. 1998년 도입, 1999년형부터 적용으로 설명하는 자료도 있음.
1998~2004년 미국 판매 약 4배(2004년 약 41만 8천 대로 보도)는 연도별 실적으로 확인하세요. 카드에는 "roughly"로 적었습니다. → [2026-11-02 확인] 2004년 418,615대(회사 발표) 확인. 1998년 약 9만 대 대비 4.6배라 "4×"를 "4.6×"로 고침.
J.D. Power 2004년 초기품질조사(IQS)에서 Hyundai가 상위권(보도에 따라 2위 공동)이었다는 내용은 J.D. Power 발표로 확인하세요. → [2026-11-02 확인] J.D. Power 2004 IQS에서 Honda와 공동 2위(Toyota 다음) 확인. 카드 문구를 구체적으로 고침.
